operational_phases.name: Pin inventory
operational_phases.outcome: Immutable repository refs, tree digests, manifests, contracts, entrypoints, tests and CI results.

operational_phases.name: Resolve identity and contracts
operational_phases.outcome: Two candidate identity mappings are either evidenced or remain blocked; no inferred aliases.

operational_phases.name: Run local verification
operational_phases.outcome: Repository-native tests and negative cases pass on pinned SHAs; receipts include run links and artifact digests.

operational_phases.name: Connect isolated adapters
operational_phases.outcome: Local/read-only cross-system smoke tests pass; unknown identity and bad signatures fail closed.

operational_phases.name: Prove persistence and replay
operational_phases.outcome: Durable receipt survives restart; retry is idempotent; independent replay matches original deterministic output.

operational_phases.name: Governed admission
operational_phases.outcome: Independent reviewer accepts evidence and VAIXLNS grants bounded authority for exact source/environment.

operational_phases.name: Stage operation
operational_phases.outcome: Health, lease, controlled isolation, recovery, re-route, telemetry and rollback evidence pass.

operational_phases.name: Production decision
operational_phases.outcome: Separate approval after security, auth, secrets, backup/restore, capacity, observability and load gates pass.
